hypothesis: Faults missing from USGS/INGENIOUS juxtapose lithologies and channel hydrothermal fluids, producing coincident radiometric-ratio (ThK/UK/UTh, K/Th/U) gradient edges + TMI_up150 gradient edges that a LiDAR-scarp-aware HGB can rank above unfaulted contacts.
mechanism: 27-band surface (12 LiDAR scarp u8 + 4 radiometric + 4 GeoDAWN extensions + 7 derived gradient-edge bands) from GEMSDOE24 public cache (USGS GeoDAWN DOI 10.5066/P93LGLVQ / USGS 3DEP); HistGradientBoosting trained on visible catalogue faults only per fold; binary dots emitted descending-score, >=2.83px separation, >2px from catalogue, inside footprint, budget 44090 chosen from pre-declared {20000,37654,44090} by pooled HOLDOUT-DTI.
named_non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted lithologic contacts, playa/caldera margins and lava-flow margins (radiometric+magnetic edges with no throughgoing fault).
